'''Poison injectors''', also known as '''Injection Fangs''', were equipped on [[Scarab Mark VI assassin droid]]s. Attached to the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] head, the fangs were connected to an internal reservoir that could be filled with a variety of [[Poison/Legends|poisons]] such as fast-acting [[Nerve toxin/Legends|nerve toxins]] or [[Hallucination/Legends|hallucinogenic]] stimulants.<ref name="EGTD" />
